answer: Each walnut vouch locks $50 times the square of its number from one voucher, so the first costs $50. A $500 registry bond buys the right to vouch. A new identity needs two vouches from different vouchers. Five auditors judge fraud proofs at a weekly summit, and a proven fake voids the identity and burns the voucher's bond. One voucher backing 100 clones locks $16,917,500, while splitting across 50 still locks $37,500, so the delta against one honest $50 vouch is at least $37,450. One cracked voice silences a whole choir row, and one fake vouch does the same.
